title: Commons Standalone Mode (SillyTavern-style): Use Viwo State toggle, session branching, and reset

sections.what: Add a 'Use Viwo State' toggle to The Commons so users can switch between Connected mode (using live Viwo world.players, world.commons, scenario clock, and Viwo phone actions) and Standalone mode (treating /commons as a standalone SillyTavern-style chat app with isolated sessions, conversation branching, and reset).
sections.why: Users want to run late-night or standalone SillyTavern-style RP in /commons without needing an active Viwo map simulation or mutating canonical Viwo campaign state, while keeping Connected mode seamless when characters text from phones inside Viwo.
sections.how:
1. Add a 'Use Viwo State' toggle in /commons header/settings (persisted per session/config).
2. In Connected mode (ON): keep existing live coupling to world.players, world.commons, scenario clock, and Viwo phone actions (bug-599).
3. In Standalone mode (OFF): run an isolated standalone CommonsSession store (loading character cards/personas from saved scenarios or character files without requiring a running map/turn queue), keeping standalone chat logs and dated memories separate from the active Viwo save.
4. Add conversation Branch (fork channel/chat from a chosen message or current point, sharing the (branch_id, world_datetime) isolation model from docs/design/timeline-and-branching-vision.md) and Reset (clear/restart current standalone conversation cleanly) endpoints and UI controls.
sections.verify: Run pytest covering standalone vs connected Commons routes, branching, and reset; verify live in /commons that toggling Use Viwo State switches cleanly without corrupting Viwo scenario state.

acceptance.text: Toggling 'Use Viwo State' ON uses live Viwo world state, characters, and phone integration seamlessly.
Toggling 'Use Viwo State' OFF runs /commons as a standalone chat session without needing an active Viwo map/turn simulation and without mutating Viwo scenario saves.
Standalone mode supports branching from a message/conversation and resetting the session cleanly.

sections.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: /commons header / Quick Settings ('Use Viwo State' toggle, Branch, Reset controls).

Manual verification steps:
1. Open /commons, switch 'Use Viwo State' OFF, pick characters, chat, branch from a message, and reset.
2. Switch 'Use Viwo State' ON and confirm Viwo scenario state and messages remain untouched.
